purpose: Concept illustrations only, not experimental results

prompts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished, scientifically correct teaching infographic for a Chinese master's thesis PowerPoint. This is an explanatory schematic, not experimental data. Output a wide 2304 x 1024 pixel image, aspect ratio 2.25:1, pure white background, no overall title, no footer, no sources, no page number, no tiny text. Flat clean vector-like drawing, navy #172B46 text, teal #007F82 predictions, orange #C36D37 prediction boxes, pale blue-gray ground-truth shapes. All Chinese text large and perfectly legible, medium-bold sans-serif. Diagrams dominate.
Layout: left two-thirds is a 2 by 2 grid of four comparison diagrams, without card borders. In every diagram the SAME rounded bean-like target is the ground truth G, pale blue-gray fill and navy outline. A thin navy dashed tight bounding rectangle is its ground-truth box. An orange solid rectangle is the predicted box. A translucent teal region is the predicted instance mask. Preserve these semantics consistently.
Upper left labeled exactly "框好 · 轮廓好": orange box tightly agrees with navy dashed box, teal mask nearly exactly covers the true target.
Upper right labeled exactly "框好 · 轮廓差": same good orange box, teal mask covers only the left half of the true target, leaving a clearly visible uncovered right half.
Lower left labeled exactly "框差 · 轮廓好": orange box is much larger, loosely enclosing the whole target (box overlap low), but teal mask still matches the true target almost perfectly. It must visibly demonstrate a good mask inside a poor large box.
Lower right labeled exactly "框差 · 轮廓差": orange box similarly much larger, teal mask covers only half the true target.
Under the four diagrams place a large compact color legend, exact text "标注区域" beside pale gray swatch, "预测轮廓" beside teal swatch, "预测框" beside orange outline, "标注框" beside navy dashed outline. Do not invent numerical IoUs.
Right third: top a fifth simple diagram with only ground-truth target and dashed box, labeled "无配对" and large explanation "未匹配到同类预测".
Right middle: a prominent stacked fraction equation, exact mathematical meaning "IoU = 重合面积 / 合并面积", with an actual horizontal fraction bar, numerator 重合面积, denominator 合并面积. Beneath it a short line "框与轮廓分别计算".
Right bottom: another prominent stacked fraction, exact meaning "框支持率 = 框内目标面积 / 目标总面积", with a horizontal fraction bar; concise explanation "检查目标是否被框完整覆盖".
Keep mathematical symbols and all Chinese characters exact. No paragraph, no footnote, no scientific performance numbers, no animals or photographs. Whitespace separates every diagram.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a high-quality explanatory infographic for a Chinese research presentation about instance segmentation errors, NOT experimental results. Wide landscape 2304 x 1024 pixels, aspect ratio 2.25:1. Pure white, clean flat vector-like scientific drawing, navy #172B46 type, thin teal #007F82 predicted-mask outline, pale blue-gray true target, orange-red #C36D37 highlighted error pixels. No overall title, no footer, no fine print. All labels large Chinese sans-serif, must remain readable at 1152 x 512.
Six equal open layout cells, 3 columns x 2 rows, no boxes around cells. First five cells are independent explanatory diagrams. Same target shape and scale throughout; use rounded irregular bean shapes, not real animals. Gray filled region is true target; teal solid closed contour is prediction. Orange hatching highlights ONLY the error category under discussion. Other regions remain muted. In neighboring-object diagrams, a second pale blue shape labeled "同类" and a pale gold shape labeled "异类" make the distinction explicit. Neighbor regions do not belong to the target. Always make prediction include the target plus the highlighted false region, except the omission diagram.
Top left label "① 自身遗漏": teal prediction encloses only part of true target; highlight the target's uncovered right-side portion orange. Under it "属于自己，却没分出来".
Top middle label "② 同类邻居误分": target on left, separate same-class neighbor on right; prediction wrongly extends into a part of that neighbor, highlight just the invaded neighbor portion orange. Under it "把同类邻居分给了自己".
Top right label "③ 异类邻居误分": same structure but neighbor is visibly labeled "异类"; prediction invades it; orange only the invaded portion. Under it "把其他类别区域分了进来".
Bottom left label "④ 邻居歧义误分": target on left, two neighbor regions on right labeled 同类 and 异类 partially overlap one another away from the target. Prediction contains the target and reaches their overlap. Highlight only the common overlap portion inside prediction, not the neighbor-exclusive portions. Under it "同类与异类标注交叠，单列统计".
Bottom middle label "⑤ 背景误分": target alone; predicted contour expands into white empty space; highlight only the extension in the white background, not the true target. Under it "把背景分给了目标".
Bottom right is the formula/explanation cell, no extra diagram. Large exact title "统一按目标面积归一化". Prominent stacked fraction equation "错误比率 = 本类错误像素数 / 有效目标像素数", with horizontal fraction bar. Under it, exact text on two clear lines: "五类分量分别保留" and "误分减少，也要保住自身覆盖".
No empirical numerical values. Do not turn this into a table. Every label must clearly belong to its own diagram.

Use case: scientific-educational. Generate a scientifically precise Chinese teaching infographic, clean white background, navy #172B46 text, teal #007F82 and blue #315E9D geometry, orange #C36D37 highlights. Wide landscape 2304x1024 pixels (2.25:1). No overall title, no page footer, no references, no small print. Large readable text, flat vector-style outlines and translucent fills. Two balanced side-by-side concept panels separated only by whitespace.
LEFT concept heading exact "ICI：框的累计交叠". Draw one central target ground-truth rectangle B_i in strong navy outline, and two same-class neighbor rectangles in teal outlines overlapping different parts of B_i. Highlight the intersections with orange diagonal hatching. Clearly show that intersection contributions are summed per neighbor (a common part may be counted for each neighbor); do NOT confuse union with sum. All rectangles are annotation boxes, not predictions. Native-style math below graphic: ICI_i = (Σ_{j≠i, 同类} |B_i ∩ B_j|) / |B_i|, use a clear proper fraction and summation if possible. Also write the plain-language fraction in large Chinese: "累计交叠面积 / 目标框面积". One concise large explanation: "看框是否拥挤，累计值可以超过 1".
RIGHT concept heading exact "E(4)：轮廓边界的接近程度". Draw a large organic ground-truth target on left, pale blue gray, navy outline; another same-class neighbor target on right, pale teal, teal outline. They should be very close but not overlap. Highlight orange ONLY the right-hand arc of the TARGET's OWN boundary nearest the neighbor. Other parts of its boundary remain navy. A subtle distance indicator between the highlighted arc and the neighboring REGION shows the radius r; label exactly "r = 4 个输入等效像素". This is distance to the neighbor's mask REGION, not a difference between prediction and GT.
Below the right diagram a large fraction equation, exact semantic text: "E(4) = 近邻边界像素数 / 全部有效边界像素数", with actual horizontal fraction bar. One concise large explanation: "看真实轮廓是否靠近其他个体".
Keep all labels and equation content exact. No invented numerical measurements or plots. No arrows implying causality. The two concepts must look visually distinct: overlapping rectangles versus neighboring irregular outlines.

Use case: scientific-educational. Draw a clear Chinese research teaching infographic explaining instance-to-prediction relationships. Wide 2304x1024 pixels, 2.25:1, white background, navy #172B46 typography, teal #007F82 prediction symbols, blue #315E9D ground-truth symbols. Flat vector-like diagram, no shadows, no overall title, no sources, no footer, no fine print. All text large enough to read projected. This is conceptual, not measured results.
Upper half: five side-by-side open comparison diagrams, each with blue circles labeled G representing ground-truth instances on the left of the tiny graph and teal squares labeled P representing predictions on its right. Thin straight lines are same-class geometric associations, not arrows.
Diagram 1 label "一对一": one G circle and one P square connected once.
Diagram 2 label "O：一对多": exactly one G circle connected to two P squares.
Diagram 3 label "M：多对一": exactly two G circles connected to one P square.
Diagram 4 label "X：多对多": exactly two G circles and two P squares forming one connected component, show all four connections.
Diagram 5 label "MISS：无关联": one G circle and one P square, NO connecting line.
Add a modest large legend beside graphs "G：真实实例    P：预测".
Lower half: left side two clean stacked-fraction equations with clear Chinese:
"覆盖率 = 重合面积 / 真实目标面积"
"纯度 = 重合面积 / 预测区域面积"
Each should have a real horizontal fraction bar; enough white space.
Lower middle/right a clearly legible 2x2 classification matrix of the one-to-one case, rows for coverage (≥0.75 versus <0.75), columns for purity (≥0.75 versus <0.75). Cell labels MUST map correctly:
coverage high + purity high: "C：两者达标";
coverage low + purity high: "I：覆盖不足";
coverage high + purity low: "L：纯度不足";
coverage low + purity low: "S：两者不足".
Make the row/column labels exact and easy to follow.
Add one prominent plain sentence as part of the body, not small print: "关系复杂不等于分割失败". Do not label O as necessarily duplicate, M as necessarily merged error, or C as guaranteed Mask75 success. No numerical experimental results.
